data.name: Musa
data.gender_notes: Musa is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Moshe, explained in Exodus 2:10 as 'drawn out' of the water. Its root is Hebrew m-sh-h. The prophet Mūsā (Moses), who received the Torah. Musa is a Arabic name meaning “Drawn out (of the water)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Musa expresses “Drawn out (of the water)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Moshe, explained in Exodus 2:10 as 'drawn out' of the water.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musa total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
